capabilities: Render an interactive animated graph of vault notes and links
Filter and scope the graph by folder, tag, date, and link count
Run auto-travel journeys and saved presentation routes
Compare notes and track vault changes against a baseline
Export PNG screenshots with an optional label-privacy mode
disambiguation: Not a graph editor: the graph is read-only and never modifies notes.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README includes detailed manual install and troubleshooting steps.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is static and minimal, offering few visual styles, exploration modes, filters, or presentation options for exploring a vault as a graph.
summary: Read-only, animated knowledge graph view of the vault with filters, scopes, auto-travel journeys, saved visual templates, and workspace tools like compare and changes.
